title: Lumera Announcement
text: As you may know, since the beginning we have been planning to create a classic Tibia 8.6 RPG server. That's also why we created Furia — a testing environment where we could experiment with different mechanics, ideas and systems.

title: Furia & Lumera
text: Furia is now stable and serves as our dedicated testing world, which means we can finally introduce Lumera. Lumera will be a classic Tibia 8.6 RPG x1 PvP world.

title: Building The Foundation
text: Our current focus is testing and reviewing the engine, mechanics, quests, NPCs, monster balance and overall gameplay consistency. Furia will remain online while Lumera is being developed.
